2026_01_TB_CIN.headline: Tampa Bay’s receiver depth is tested against a Cincinnati offense built to force a shootout
2026_01_TB_CIN.paragraph1: Tampa Bay enters Cincinnati with Jalen McMillan, Sean Tucker and Justin Skule doubtful, while the Bengals have Joe Burrow healthy and Ja’Marr Chase available despite a late rest-related practice absence. The Buccaneers still have enough skill talent to challenge Cincinnati, but protection and receiver availability make sustained drives more difficult. Cincinnati’s revamped defense must avoid giving up explosives, while Tampa Bay needs its pass rush and coverage to keep Burrow from repeatedly attacking favorable matchups outside the numbers.
2026_01_TB_CIN.model_rationale: Cincinnati can stress Tampa Bay’s thinner offensive personnel by forcing a higher-scoring pace, while the Buccaneers need pressure and explosive-play prevention to keep Burrow uncomfortable.
